note: Config-less front-end shim. Its only live state is the asset library jquery_deprecated_functions/global-scripts (header:true, JS weight -20, depends on core/jquery), attached on every page via the info.yml libraries key and hook_page_attachments (OOP hook class JqueryDeprecatedFunctionsHooks). Medium cases introspect the live library registry via library.discovery. Hard cases require the module to be installed so the shims exist (reset uninstalls it; verify checks the module is installed and the library is discoverable). All grounded in real code: real function list ($.trim, $.isFunction, $.parseJSON, ...), real library id/metadata.

evals.prompt: Why would a Drupal 11 site need the jquery_deprecated_functions module, and does it require any configuration after enabling it?
evals.expected_output: Drupal 11 ships jQuery 4, which removed many utility functions that older JS/contrib code still calls, causing errors. The module re-adds them site-wide. It needs no configuration - just enable it.

evals.prompt: Name several of the deprecated jQuery functions that the jquery_deprecated_functions module restores.
evals.expected_output: It restores $.trim, $.isFunction/$.fn.isFunction, $.type, $.isArray, $.camelCase, $.isWindow, $.nodeName, $.isNumeric, jQuery.now, jQuery.parseJSON, $.unique/$.fn.unique, plus jQuery.fx.interval, jQuery.cssNumber and jQuery.cssProps.

evals.prompt: What is the name of the asset library that jquery_deprecated_functions defines, and how is it attached to pages?
evals.expected_output: The library is jquery_deprecated_functions/global-scripts. It is attached to every page both via the libraries: key in the module .info.yml and via hook_page_attachments() (the OOP hook class JqueryDeprecatedFunctionsHooks). It depends on core/jquery and loads in the header.

evals.prompt: Inspect this running Drupal site's asset library registry and report which core library the jquery_deprecated_functions/global-scripts library depends on.
evals.expected_output: The global-scripts library declares a dependency on core/jquery (visible via \Drupal::service('library.discovery')->getLibraryByName('jquery_deprecated_functions','global-scripts')).

evals.prompt: Inspect the live asset library definition for jquery_deprecated_functions/global-scripts on this site. Is it configured to load in the page header, and what is the JS file's weight?
evals.expected_output: Yes, it loads in the header (header: true) and its single JS file has weight -20, so the shims are defined before other scripts run.

evals.prompt: This Drupal 11 site must provide the jQuery 4 compatibility shims (e.g. $.trim, $.isFunction) on every page. Make sure the jquery_deprecated_functions module is installed and its global-scripts library is available on the site.
evals.expected_output: The jquery_deprecated_functions module is installed (drush en jquery_deprecated_functions) and the jquery_deprecated_functions/global-scripts asset library resolves in the library registry.

evals.prompt: After moving my site to the newest Drupal, one of my add-ons stopped working and the browser console complains that $.trim is not a function. Please install the fix that brings those old jQuery helper functions back to the whole site.
evals.expected_output: Enabling the jquery_deprecated_functions module restores the removed jQuery utilities globally; the module is installed and its global-scripts library is available.
